q: Can we hold a banquet at your restaurant?
a:
Of course, YES.
We can offer a separate banquet hall for up to 35 people. The hall is perfect for birthdays, weddings, gender parties, corporate events, business meetings and breakfasts. The hall is fully equipped with everything you need: screen and projector, sound system, light show, flipchart.
We have a banquet and a buffet menu!
There is no corkage fee and no hall rental, and no charge for using anything in the banquet hall either.
We assign dedicated waiters to your event, trained and familiar with all the details and nuances of banquets.
Call +79220281406 and our banquet manager Evgenia will be happy to answer all your questions and offer a solution for any request.

q: Can we celebrate a child's birthday at your restaurant?
a: Absolutely. We can seat you in several halls, including the banquet hall. There you can hold master classes, invite entertainers, have fun and eat well — we also have a children's menu. And there is a sound system and a light show)

Yes, our restaurant has three.
The "VIP room" seats 10-12 people, the "Banquet room" holds up to 25 people. And there is a separate banquet hall for 35 people, which is very popular for anniversaries, weddings, corporate parties and other large events. You can get all the information about the banquet hall from our banquet manager Evgenia at +79220281406
We look forward to your call!

q: Why can't all dishes be ordered for delivery?
a: Some of our dishes are meant to be served in front of the guest and are prepared only inside the restaurant. You can always choose an alternative for your order or consult the delivery manager about the dishes you are interested in. And, of course, you can try these dishes when you visit the restaurant
